insights: Puzzle-piece aesthetic creates visual metaphor for modular, interconnected research approach - geometric blocks in brand colors (red, black, blue) serve as both navigation and brand expression

Architectural border system with notched connectors creates visual flow between sections while maintaining clear content hierarchy - borders match section color coding (red=Research, black=Approach/Vision, blue=Team)
Generous whitespace strategy (88px-176px gaps) on desktop creates breathing room and emphasis, while mobile scales proportionally (72px-144px) maintaining spatial rhythm without feeling cramped
Color-coded square bullets and section borders create systematic visual language - each major theme has dedicated accent color reinforcing content organization and aiding scanability
